_comment: Copy this file to mcp.json and edit. mcp.json is gitignored. Two server shapes are supported: stdio (spawns a local process) and http (connects to a remote Streamable HTTP / SSE endpoint).

playwright._comment: 浏览器操作车道（add-browser-use-lane）。桌面/本地 opt-in 启用步骤：① `npm install -g @playwright/mcp@0.0.80`（或装进任意目录），运行一次 `npx playwright install chromium` 装浏览器；② 在 .env 设置 BROWSER_MCP_CLI=<该包的 cli.js 绝对路径>（+ PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<浏览器目录>）；③ 车道本身随 platform.bundle.json 的 playwright 条目供给，无需在此再声明——本块只是说明；供给门三形态与 BROWSER_LANE=off 见 .env.example。确认 MCP 市场里启用了条目。

fleet.comment: Fleet report_status tool (agent-fleet-report-lane) — loopback bridge to the platform server.
